hero.label: The Opportunity
hero.static_content: Your demand potential is real, but execution bandwidth is the constraint. Capacity work creates operating leverage so growth does not depend on personal overextension.

foundation.label: What You've Built
foundation.static_content: You have valuable channels and opportunities, but they compete for finite attention. Without systemization, quality drops and strategic consistency disappears.

gtm_strategy.label: The Play
gtm_strategy.static_content: Create a leverage stack: content operating system, reusable campaign frameworks, decision rules, and delegated production so strategic voice stays high while execution scales.

roadmap.label: 90-Day Roadmap
roadmap.static_content: Phase 1: simplify priorities and define operating cadence. Phase 2: document workflows and launch delegated execution. Phase 3: automate recurring motions and raise throughput.

work_weve_done.label: Work We've Done
work_weve_done.static_content: Opika has helped founder-led brands increase output quality and velocity by replacing heroic effort with repeatable systems and clear ownership.

ask.label: What We're Asking
ask.static_content: Commit to operational clarity for one quarter. You stay focused on strategic voice and insights; we build the systems that protect quality while expanding capacity.
